Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 s_pending_units number(4);
begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select count(*) into s_pending_units
 from holding_tests ht
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and result_status_1 is not null
 and result_status_2 is not null
 and holding_status is null
 and exists (select test_id from valid_tests
 where test_id = ht.test_id 
 and test_group not in 
 (SELECT code FROM master_codes 
 WHERE code_type = 'ANTGR'
 AND sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate)
 )
 ) 
 and exists (select tb_id from test_batch_det
 where tb_id = ht.tb_id 
 and test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id 
 and (testing_lab_code = :s_testing_lab_code 
 or :s_testing_lab_code = '99')
 and nvl(reconcile_flag,'N') != 'Y'
 and test_type = 'M')
 and not exists (select 'x' from holding_tests
 where tb_id = ht.tb_id
 and test_id = ht.test_id
 and test_chapter_id = ht.test_chapter_id
 and (temp_result_1 is null or
 temp_result_2 is null))
 and test_id not in (select distinct test_id from valid_band_results);
 if s_pending_units = 0 then
 show_error('1233');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_PROC
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE COMMIT_PROC IS
 test_id varchar2(10);
 cur_rec number(4) := :system.cursor_record;
 rg_id RecordGroup;
 gc_id1 GroupColumn;
 gc_id2 GroupColumn;
 found Boolean; 
 msg varchar2(100);
BEGIN
 GO_BLOCK('S_HOLDING_TESTS');
 FIRST_RECORD;
 rg_id := FIND_GROUP('RES_CNT');
 IF not ID_NULL(rg_id) THEN
 delete_group(rg_id);
 END IF;
 rg_id := CREATE_GROUP('RES_CNT');
 gc_id1 := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id,'RES',CHAR_COLUMN,10);
 gc_id2 := ADD_GROUP_COLUMN(rg_id,'CNT',NUMBER_COLUMN);
 loop 
 IF :s_holding_tests.inp_result_status_1 is not null THEN
 found := FALSE; 
 for i in 1.. GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id)
 loop 
 IF GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id1,i) = :s_holding_tests.inp_result_status_1 THEN
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,i, GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,i) + 1);
 found := TRUE;
 END IF;
 end loop;
 IF not found THEN
 ADD_GROUP_ROW(rg_id,END_OF_GROUP);
 SET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id1,GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id),:s_holding_tests.inp_result_status_1);
 SET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id),1);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 NEXT_RECORD;
 end loop;
 go_record(cur_rec);
 IF GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id) = 0 THEN
 show_error('8013');
 END IF;
 msg := 'Results Entered - ';
 for i in 1..GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(rg_id)
 loop
 msg := msg || to_char(GET_GROUP_NUMBER_CELL(gc_id2,i)) || ':';
 msg := msg || GET_GROUP_CHAR_CELL(gc_id1,i) || '; ';
 end loop;
 show_error('9200',msg);
 savepoint A;
 FIRST_RECORD;
 loop
 IF :s_holding_tests.inp_result_status_1 is not null
 THEN
 :s_holding_tests.result_status_1 := :s_holding_tests.inp_result_status_1;
 :s_holding_tests.result_status_2 := null;
 :s_holding_tests.temp_result_2_user_id := :banner.user_id;
 :s_holding_tests.program_id := :banner.prog_name;
 :s_holding_tests.result_dats := sysdate;
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 next_record;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 post;
 MOVE_RESULTS;
 commit_form;
 IF not FORM_SUCCESS THEN
 rollback to A;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('0230');
 ELSE
 :system.message_level := 0;
 show_error('0000') ;
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM'); 
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: MOVE_RESULTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE MOVE_RESULTS IS
 tresult varchar2(80);
 temp_x varchar2(1);
BEGIN
 SELECT distinct 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM holding_tests
 WHERE test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 AND tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND (result_status_1 is null
 OR result_status_2 is not null);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 /* Commented by Sobha per the new requirements in the Testing Module */
 /* tresult := sbclib.move_holding_tests(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.test_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id,
 null,
 :banner.prog_name); */
 BEGIN
 SELECT distinct 'x' 
 INTO :GLOBAL.x 
 FROM test_batch_parms
 WHERE chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 AND test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 DECLARE
 tresult varchar2(80);
 BEGIN
 tresult := sbclib.move_holding_tests(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.test_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id,
 null,
 :banner.prog_name);
 IF nvl(tresult,'null') != '0' THEN
 show_error('3106',tresult);
 END IF;
 END;
 END; 
 
 WHEN others THEN
 message('Error in moving tests');
 handle_error;
END;
